answer: Let no grading panel seat more than one account from the same invite branch, meaning any two accounts that trace back to a shared inviter within 2 hops. If one root invited 300 accounts, a panel on someone's knoll erosion report or prism coating spec still gets at most one of them, so the farm casts one vote out of five no matter how big it grows. To get more it needs invites from lots of separate real members. Honest graders mostly came in through unrelated people, and even at the nadir of a quiet epoch, with 30 graders online, panels still fill fine.
